title: Quick Japanese Udon Noodle Soup
description: A simple and comforting Japanese noodle soup made with udon noodles and a flavorful broth.

ingredients.name: Quick dashi broth
ingredients.notes: Available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large pot, combine the dashi broth, soy sauce, and grated ginger.
Bring the broth to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the flaky salmon fillet to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until cooked through.
Stir in the sesame oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Divide the cooked udon noodles among bowls and ladle the hot broth over the top.
Garnish with sliced green onions and serve immediately.
